连续系数的标准线性初值问题有唯一解，初始数据与解构成线性一一对应，因此解空间维数: A standard continuous-coefficient linear initial-value problem has a unique solution. Initial data and solutions correspond linearly and bijectively, making solution-space dimension equal to order. A fundamental determinant satisfies $\det\Phi(t)=\det\Phi(t_0)\exp(\int_{t_0}^t\operatorname{tr}A(s)ds)$, derived by differentiating its columns. Independent initial solutions therefore cannot suddenly lose independence on a regular interval.
本卷采用单边因果 Laplace 变换，普通初值取零时刻右极限。严格正时间的冲激: We use one-sided causal Laplace transforms with ordinary initial data taken as right limits at zero. Strictly positive-time impulses are generalized functions and transform into exponential delay factors. Full distribution theory and engineering conventions for impulses at zero are outside the derivation. Single-point values of ordinary piecewise functions do not affect transforms. Classical differential equalities hold separately on each side of jumps, with distributional jump conditions where needed.
稳定表示所有足够近初值始终保持近；渐近稳定还要求趋近平衡。非线性线性化结论依赖平: Stability means all sufficiently close initial states stay close; asymptotic stability also requires convergence to equilibrium. Nonlinear linearization assumes continuous differentiability near equilibrium. Hyperbolic cases use the linearized stability theorem, while pure-imaginary or zero roots need further study. A nonpositive Lyapunov derivative directly gives a nonincrease estimate; attraction requires examining invariant motions within the zero-derivative set. We do not prove Hartman-Grobman or general invariance principles here.

普通点解析性与 Frobenius 存在理论作为标准局部定理使用；递推算例在各节: Ordinary-point analyticity and Frobenius existence are used as standard local theorems, with recurrences calculated independently in each lesson. Step doubling estimates local asymptotic error rather than guaranteeing global error. Finite grids, fixed steps, and finite visual windows are not theorem proofs.
